title: trigger-kind
description: A plugin-shipped trigger contract: the settings a trigger of this kind carries (its own vocabulary), and the context it hands a run -- what a trigger's input mapping and resolvers read as request.*. A setting of type `type` may bind a variable the context names (body: $Body); a string setting may bind its {name} placeholders, as an object of required strings (route: $Params).

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/trigger-kind.schema.json.

description.description: What makes a trigger of this kind fire, in one or two sentences.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

correlation.description: The dotted path, within this kind's context, of the value that correlates a run with the caller's own trace (e.g. headers.traceparent). It must name a field this kind's context hands (T007). The runtime copies it into the trace as an opaque string; parsing it is the exporter's business. Absent: runs of this kind carry no correlation.

refusals.description: The dotted path, within a trigger's settings, of the map from a refusal's reason to how this kind answers it (e.g. response.refusals). Declared: every reason a trigger of this kind can reach must be a key of that map (T005), and every key must be a reason it can reach (T006). Absent: the kind answers every refusal one way.
